facts.statement: The genus Protosuchus was described by Brown in 1934.
Protosuchus fossils date to the Early Jurassic period.
Protosuchus has been synonymized with Archaeosuchus, Baroqueosuchus, and Lesothosuchus.
facts.quote: synonyms: * Archaeosuchus Brown, 1933 (preoccupied) Baroqueosuchus Busbey and Gow, 1984 Lesothosuchus Whetstone and Whybrow, 1983

facts.statement: Protosuchus belongs to the suborder Protosuchia.
Protosuchus is classified within the family Protosuchidae.
Protosuchus lived approximately 200 to 184 million years ago during the Norian and Rhaetian stages.
facts.quote: hace aproximadamente 200 a 184 millones de años, en el Noriense y Rhaetiense

facts.statement: Protosuchus fossils have been found in what is now North America and possibly South Africa.
facts.quote: en lo que hoy es Norteamérica y posiblemente Sudáfrica

facts.statement: Protosuchus was about 80 centimeters in length.
facts.quote: Protosuchus was about 80 cm in length.

facts.statement: Protosuchus had short jaws that broadened at the skull base to provide a large attachment surface for jaw muscles.
facts.quote: It had short jaws that broadened out at the base of the skull, providing a large surface to which its jaw muscles could attach.

facts.statement: Protosuchus possessed dentition resembling modern crocodiles, with lower jaw teeth fitting into notches on the upper jaw.
facts.quote: The dentition of the animal also resembled modern crocodiles, including the teeth in the lower jaw that fitted into notches on either side of the upper jaw when the mouth was closed.

facts.statement: Protosuchus was a quadrupedal reptile with columnar legs where the rear legs were longer than the front legs.
facts.quote: It was an unusual quadrupedal reptile whose legs were columnar, with the rear legs longer than the front legs.

facts.statement: Protosuchus possessed a powerful tail used for propulsion while moving in water.
facts.quote: Poseía una poderosa cola con la que podía propulsarse mientras se movía en el agua

facts.statement: Protosuchus likely fed on terrestrial animals the size of a lizard.
facts.quote: el Protosuchus probablemente se alimentaba con animales terrestres del tamaño de una lagartija

facts.statement: Protosuchus lived in rivers and swamps.
facts.quote: Protosuchus vivía en ríos y pantanos

facts.statement: Protosuchus existed from the Rhaetian to the Sinemurian, between 205.7 and 192.9 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Rhaetian to Sinemurian (205.7 to 192.9 million years ago)

facts.statement: There are 16 recorded fossil occurrences of Protosuchus in the Paleobiology Database.
Researchers interpreting the holotype of Erythrochampsa longipes suggest it may belong to or be a relative of Protosuchus.
facts.quote: interpret its holotype as likely to be fossil material of a member or a relative of the genus Protosuchus

rejected.statement: Protosuchus had a body reinforced by osteoderms arranged in a double row along the back and covering the belly and tail.
rejected.quote: The body was covered and reinforced by osteoderms in a double row along the back and covering the bottom of the body and the entire tail.
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'in a double row along the back and'
